lines.trans: Misha, be a realist, to her you are small fry.
Vitya, in the past I froze on the street for five years.
Who would have thought that I would manage a hotel?
Tomorrow I will secretly invite her to a romantic dinner.
And at the table I will lay all my cards on the table!
And where are you planning to invite her tomorrow?
To our restaurant, but the main thing is I want to surprise her.
Wait, is that a real white truffle you have there?
Did you identify it right by its subtle scent?
No, I can see it with my eyes, close the door tightly right now!
Your daughter said that this is Eleonora's favorite delicacy.
Hold it carefully, Vitya, tomorrow evening you will cook it for her!
